description: Get raw posts from a user search. The first line says how many of the profile's posts this response shows and the offset of the next page; total, returned and offset are in the JSON. Read a large search in pages with offset and limit, and fields=lean when the text matters more than media and profile URLs. A response over the size cap is marked truncated: true.

fields.description: lean leaves out media_url, profile_url and sentiment_reason, so roughly twice as many posts fit in one response (default: full)

limit.description: Posts per page, 1 to 1000 (default: every remaining post)

offset.description: Posts to skip (default 0). To read the next page, use the offset the previous response's first line gives.

name: get_user_search_posts
